entry.description: Keep a logging call from throwing when an exception cannot render itself. The internal log wrote `exception.ToString()` unguarded, so an exception whose `ToString()` threw again escaped every catch block that reports through it, and `ILog.InfoFormat` and the like threw into the application. The internal log, the error text of a failed rendering and the last-resort exception text of `LoggingEvent` now fall back to the type names (ANT-2026-F4RWPVSV, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
